name: Dayana Esperence
text: Uses (3 secrets). [fast]: Attach a non-weakness [[Spell]] event from your hand to Dayana Esperence. Limit 1 event attached to her. The attached event may be played as if it were in your hand. It is not placed in your discard pile after it is played (it remains attached). As an additional cost to play the attached event, exhaust Dayana Esperence and spend 1 secret.
text_cn: 使用(3秘密)。 [free]：将一张非弱点[[法术]]事件卡从你的手牌叠加到黛雅娜·艾丝帕伦斯。被叠加到其身上的事件卡限制1张。 可以打出被叠加的事件卡，如同其在你的手牌中。将其打出后，不放到你的弃牌堆(其仍维持叠加)。作为打出打出被叠加事件卡的额外费用，消耗黛雅娜·艾丝帕伦斯并花费1秘密。
